text:
dave: Heads-up: Helios Labs invited us for an in-lab bakeoff focusing on tokens/sec per watt next Wed. They want a short methods appendix for a joint blog. Who can own the bench templates and telemetry capture?

lin: I can drive the templates. Do we have a recommended PDU cadence? Helios said their meters report at 1Hz but they also have rack-level PDUs at 5s. We should reconcile.

tay: We'll standardize on NVML at 1s and PDU at 2s, then align via timestamps. Important to sync clocks (chronyd) and dump `dmesg -T` at start.

dave: Agreed. Workload suggestion: two modes 16-bit quantized large model inference (steady) and FP16 dense (throughput-focused). Runtimes: triton 2.x and torch 2.1. Capture 10-min warmup + 30-min steady windows.

lin: Proposed phases: warmup 10m, steady low-concurrency (batch=1) 30m, medium (batch=16) 30m, high (batch=64) 20m. Also run a short KV-cache retention test: 1k repeated prompts with cache hits to capture tail behavior.

ops-bot: Note: make sure to collect `nvidia-persistenced` status and use `nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv` every 5s.

dave: Artifact naming: `helios-<date>-<site>-<gpu>-q8-b<batch>.tar.gz`. Upload location `s3://redwood-partner-bench/helios/` with ACL group `helios-bench-team`.

lin: Runner snippet I'll check in: 
./bench_runner.sh --model=redwood-7b-q8 --seq=4096 --batch=16 --duration=2400 \
  --nvml-interval=1 --pdu-interval=2 --sync-clock --trace-kv --out=helios-$(date +%F)-run

tay: Also capture environment: `cat /etc/os-release`, `pip freeze`, `rocm-smi --showtemp` (if AMD), plus kernel build id: `cat /proc/version_signature` or `uname -v`.

dave: Helios requested an embargo on numbers until their product launch (target July 15). Legal wants a short embargo clause added. legal-bot: can you add a template?

legal-bot: Draft embargo blurb: "Results are embargoed until July 15, 2026. Distribution limited to listed participants; please do not publish without written consent from Helios Labs and Redwood Inference." I'll add to the S3 README and cc internal counsel.

lin: Timeline: Fri internal smoke test on our staging rack, Mon partner run coordination, Wed Helios lab bakeoff, Fri internal parity run. Can everyone confirm?

tay: Smoke test Fri works. I'll build the container and push to `gcr.io/redwood-bench/helios:sha-0423` by Thu EOD.

dave: Ops checklist: ensure NTP sync, set PDU labels, verify power feed names, and collect rack thermal sensors. Tay, can you add a small python script to correlate NVML and PDU samples by timestamp?

tay: yes, will add `scripts/sync_power.py` to the repo. It will align samples to the nearest NVML timestamp and compute per-second power and token/s per watt.

lin: After the partner run let's produce two artifacts: (1) raw telemetry tarball, (2) a sanitized CSV with P95 latency, mean tokens/s, mean watts, and perf/W. We'll keep raw logs behind ACL until embargo lift.

dave: One more thing: Helios asked for kernel tunables list if we modify `nv_peer_mem` or similar. If we change any kernel/driver knobs, log the exact config and only change one variable at a time.

ops-bot: Created bench job `helios-bakeoff-v1` and assigned `lin` as owner.

dave: Action items recap: lin -> runner templates + artifact naming; tay -> container + sync script; legal-bot -> embargo blurb + ACL note; ops -> confirm PDU labeling with Helios. Re-meet Tue 10am PT to review smoke test output.

lin: I'll post the bench PR and the sample output format by Thu.

tay: I'll push the container and preview the sync script by Thu night.

dave: Thanks team. Keep changes minimal during runs (no kernel + quant changes at same time) so impact is attributable. :mag_right:
